provenance.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: a 4-column × 3-row 12-frame alien running atlas. Image 2 is the required EXACT pose control. Image 3 is the original alien identity.
Correct ONE problem: the atlas does not follow the near/far limb motion specified by the control. Repose both arms and both legs in EVERY cell to exactly match its corresponding cell in image 2, retaining identity, clothing, head size, camera, equal grid, authentic detailed rendering, and genuine transparency. Do not keep image 1 arm or leg pose when it differs from image 2. Do not copy a single running pose to all cells.
Image 2 RED segments identify the same foreground/NEAR arm and leg in every cell. BLUE is the far arm and leg. Final red or blue limbs are forbidden; both have the natural skin and clothing of image 3. Follow connected shoulder→elbow→wrist chains, not just isolated hand positions. This is strict right-facing side view.
Near arm for frame1 (upper-left): points BACKWARDS/LEFT and near fist behind the pelvis. Frame2 (top row second cell): near elbow beside left hip, near fist still BEHIND pelvis, far fist in front. Frame3: near arm passes down beside hip. Frame4: near forearm now forward at waist height. Frame5: near arm forward. Frame6: near elbow and fist swing forward/up. Frame7: near arm maximum FORWARD/RIGHT while near heel folds BACK/LEFT. Frame8: near arm forward descending. Frame9: near hand forward at mid-height. Frame10: near hand passes waist toward back. Frame11: near arm down beside torso. Frame12: near elbow and fist BEHIND/LEFT of pelvis; far fist forward. Near wrist must visibly traverse BEHIND→DOWN→FORWARD→DOWN→BEHIND around the whole cycle. The far arm is opposite in each cell. At least frames1,2,12 must clearly show the nearest arm sweeping backwards, NOT a front fist from the identity pose.
Near leg (red control): support/contact in cells1–3, folded recovery in cells5–8, high knee in cells9–10, extension before next contact in cells11–12. Far leg (blue control): folded recovery in cells1–3, forward high knee and extension cells4–6, support/contact in cells7–9, recovery cells10–12. Cells7–12 must exchange which side supports, not repeat cells1–6. Exactly TWO arms and TWO legs, correct knees, far limbs visible. Include the intermediate passing poses and airborne phases of image2.
Keep same fixed orthographic view, hip x registration, same clothing details, brown rugged boots and constant pixels-per-unit scale. Keep every full figure inside its own cell with transparent margins and planted soles at common baseline. Remove colored red/yellow edge speckles; natural clean soft alpha edges. No text, guides, markers or scenery. Output final real rendered transparent 12-frame animation sheet, 4 columns by 3 rows.
